paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search Using a Josephson Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
notes: ADMX sidecar cavity search using JTWPA. New exclusion of axion-photon coupling above ~1e-13 GeV^-1 over 4796.7-4799.5 MHz (axion mass ~19.84 ueV). DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cc. Limit plot (Fig. 7) shows g_agamma vs frequency; only approximate single representative point extractable from text since detailed curve values not tabulated.
